text:
ida: hypothetically: if your favorite LLM lived in your apartment, what weirdly specific house rule would it enforce?
ben: only allowing snacks with high token density. chips are considered low information. :potato: :eyes:
soph: it would triage incoming mail and assign priority scores. spam gets flagged 'low relevance' and recycled.
ida: it would also insist on versioned bed sheets. 'please upgrade to bedding v2.1 for better stability at night.' :sheet:
ben: passive-aggressive sticky note: 'I reduced your thermostat by 2C. Temperature drift detected.' :thermometer:
soph: and a nightly log entry: `2026-03-19 02:01 - apologizing for illuminating your face with validation loss graphs while you sleep` :zzz: :bar_chart:
ops-bot: System: Kitchen policy update 1 - please annotate all communal leftovers with `model:nom_nom, confidence:0.76` to avoid reclamation.
ida: imagine apologizing in the form of a release note: 'Fix: apologized for stealing snacks; added 1 new empathy prompt; breaking change: will now playlist-curate at 3am.'
ben: would it also write micro-essays explaining why the spoon was moved? yes. it would.
soph: poll idea: karaoke for models -> 'Model: Karaoke song' i suggest adding an option "Fine-Tune Remix" for people who think the model will rewrite classics.
ida: bonus: it leaves a feedback form on your pillow: 'Rate the quality of your dreams, 1-5, optional comments encouraged.'
ben: signature line: `-- your roommate, a slightly overfitted generative model` :laughing:
ops-bot: System: Poll created by ida: "Which model roommate habit would you ban?" options: "Snack score policing" "3am playlist remixes" "Versioned bedding" "Logs at bedtime". Poll closes in 72 hours. :ballot_box_with_check:
soph: gif submission: LLM in slippers clutching a steaming mug that says 'I overfit on midnight pizza'.
